scope: Eight deliberate evidence-contract mutations; not a whole-project mutation score

results.name: failed flow may prove a claim
failedTests: kane-judge demo replays the committed run and sees every cheat refused, with no Kane account
evidence or it didn't happen (enforced in code) rejects a proven claim whose Kane flow failed, or that has no flow or no Kane result

results.name: zero assertions may prove a claim
failedTests: lie 3: a pass that asserted nothing can't prove a claim when Kane's evidence holds no passed assert step

results.name: claim may borrow another claim's flow
failedTests: lie 2: a claim borrows another claim's passing flow is refused when the flow was run for a different claim

results.name: changed test may prove a fix
failedTests: lie 5: renaming a flow to reset its history can't present a weakened test as a fix
fix proof: the same test must fail, then pass refuses a flow that was edited between the failing and the passing run
fix proof: the same test must fail, then pass anchors to the first failing run: a test weakened after it failed can't prove a fix, however it gets to green
pre-flight verdict rules rejects a recorded fix unless Kane saw the same test fail and then pass
additional record tampering keeps the original failure anchor after more than thirty retries

results.name: pack hash mismatch is ignored
failedTests: lie 9: a results file that says more than Kane's sealed pack is refused when the pack is not the file Kane sealed

results.name: current status is not compared to sealed evidence
failedTests: report boundary against a real recorded Kane pack refuses a failed flow relabelled passed only in the current result

results.name: missing packs are accepted
failedTests: lie 9: a results file that says more than Kane's sealed pack passes when results and pack agree, and refuses a pack that isn't there to read
report boundary against a real recorded Kane pack refuses deleting the pack instead of answering its contradictory evidence

results.name: skipped tests may label a product broken
failedTests: claim semantics skipped is not evidence of a broken product
claim semantics interrupted is not evidence of a broken product
claim semantics broken is not evidence of a broken product
claim semantics no-steps is not evidence of a broken product
claim semantics unknown is not evidence of a broken product
